pride_data.title: Identifying interactors through BioID2 in rat cortical neurons
pride_data.projectDescription: Utilizing proximity labeling technolgy coupled to LC-MS/MS to identify TTBK1 and TTBK2 unique interactors in rat cortical neurons
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Neurons were treated after 2 days in vitro with TTBK1, TTBK2, or control GFP containing virus. Seven days following virus transduction, 20µM biotin was added to the neuron media and incubated for 16 hours. Neurons were harvested by first being washed with cold PBS and then lysed in lysis buffer (0.5M NaCl, 50mM Tris-HCl, 0.2% SDS, 1mM DTT). 60µl of 25% Triton X-100 was added to each sample and sonicated briefly for 10 seconds until clear. The lysate was centrifuged at 15,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C and the supernatants were collected. The protein concentration of each sample was measured by Bradford assay and normalized using 50mM Tris-HCl.  Streptavidin magnetic Dynabeads (Life Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) were washed with 50mM Tris-HCl two times. An equal volume of beads was added to each sample, ensuring that 30-50µl of beads were used per mg of protein. The bead-sample mixture was rotated end-over-end overnight at 4°C, after which the protein-coated beads were washed twice with 2% SDS using gentle rotation for 5 minutes. The beads were washed in this way again with wash buffer (0.1% Na-DOC, 1% Triton X-100, 0.5M NaCl, 50mM HEPES pH 7.5, 1µM EDTA), followed by (0.5% Na-DOC, 250uM LiCl, 0.5% NP-40, 10mM Tris-HCl, 1µM EDTA). The beads were washed once with 50mM Tris-HCl using gentle rotation for 5 minutes and eluted with 40µl of elution buffer (1x LDS, 0.02M DTT, 4mM Biotin) for 20 minutes at 98°C. This elution step was repeated one more time and the final eluate was collected.  Sample preparation was performed as described in the autophosphorylation methods section. The resulting peptide mixture was analyzed on a 1D nanoLC-MS/MS platform using a standardized 140 m method. Peptides were separated on an C18-AQ column (75 μm × 50 cm, Reprosil-Pur C18-AQ, 1.9 μm) at 250 nL/min.  The mass spectrometer was a QExactive HF (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) set to acquire data in a data-dependent fashion selecting and fragmenting the 10 most intense precursor ions in the ion trap where the exclusion window was set at 60 seconds and multiple charge states of the same ion were allowed.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Peptide levels among different treatments were compared by two-way ANOVA test followed by Benjamini Hochberg (B-H) adjustment for multiple testing. Unique proteins were filtered by p-value<0.01, and fold change >1.2
